title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: EMPOWER!-Enabling Meaningful Participation of Women and girls for Essential Rights- has the goal of protecting and empowering the most vulnerable women and girls in Melut, Upper Nile, South Sudan. EMPOWER aims to raise awareness and shift behaviours on education, gender equality, protection, and GBV. Addressing GBV through prevention, response and referral pathways is a core element of the programme; in addition to overcoming the barriers to girls’ education, providing safe, gender sensitive learning environments with quality teaching. The project will reach 33,261 women, men, girls and boys in 2023 with education and protection services.OBJECTIVES: Improved local provision education services which are gender responsive, conflict-sensitive, safe, inclusive learning spaces for vulnerable children, particularly girlsOUTCOMES: Increased equitable access to quality, inclusive, safe, gender-responsive education and learning for vulnerable children, particularly girls
